ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a ratio of approximately 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark mass across the central and medial regions; high-contrast high-intensity white blobs localized on the distal tips of both left and right lobes; distributed white mottling (speckling) across the central-lower region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a wide pixel angle and minimal depth relative to the overall horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and irregular amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the upper edge leading to slightly upturned, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) situated on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths across the dark pigment of both lobes, particularly visible in the mid-section and near the distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the extreme tips and significant white linear scarring/rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, protruding calcified clusters (barnacle caps) on the leading and distal edges of both fluke tips.
